channel.name: 🥟-bio
channel.topic:
**BIO** (Bao I/O): the RISC-V based I/O coprocessor from bunnie's Baochip-1x, and work on improving it, such as Mike Bell's FemtoRV based rewrite.

**Docs**
• [BIO: The Bao I/O Coprocessor](https://www.bunniestudios.com/blog/2026/bio-the-bao-i-o-coprocessor/): bunnie's write-up
• [Baochip](https://baochip.com/): chip, docs, tools and hardware
**Source**
• [baochip-1x](https://github.com/baochip/baochip-1x): the chip source
• [bio-sim](https://github.com/baochip/bio-sim): RTL simulation of the BIO CPU
• [bio-loader](https://github.com/baochip/bio-loader): load BIO code onto a Dabao board
